name: LBi HR HelpDesk
summary: LBi HR HelpDesk is HR case management software from LBi Software. Cases can be created by email or through the self-service portal, and the product keeps an FAQ and wiki knowledge base and a real-time case history. The vendor's news page gives a starting price of $1,530 a year on annual billing.

facts.text: The HR HelpDesk page lists an employee self-service portal and 'Email > case creation' under case management.
LBi HR HelpDesk's page lists a full knowledge base in FAQs and an embedded wiki knowledge base.
Real-time case history is listed on the page, which says the software tracks cases to closure. It does not say whether employees, as opposed to HR staff, can see the status of their own cases.
The LBi news page lists a Free tier for up to 100 employees and two administrative users with no expiry, and Pro and ProPlus tiers with 30-day free trials.

plans.name: Free
plans.unit: up to 100 employees and 2 administrative users
plans.notes: No expiration date, as stated on the news page.

plans.name: Pro
plans.unit: up to 500 employees and 10 administrative users
plans.notes: Free for 30 days. The news page gives one figure, 'starting at $1,530 per year' on annual billing, and does not say which tier it applies to.

plans.name: ProPlus
plans.unit: up to 2,000 employees and 20 administrative users
plans.notes: Free for 30 days. See the Pro note on the single starting figure.

hiddenCosts: The news page shows a dollar sign without a currency code. The figure is recorded as shown.
